_comment: qa with the pi-native engine: boot a single-process web app on localhost and let Mimo drive a browser toward ONE goal every 12h. Read-only against the app; boots it, tests it, tears the whole process tree down. Copy to config/targets.json and adjust path/start_cmd/port/goal.

app.goal: Exercise the core flow: the main action (upload / search / submit) is present and works, results render without JS errors, and empty/error states are graceful. Report broken UI, console errors, failed network requests, and stuck/slow states.
